item.title: Beacon 0.6.0
item.description:
System Settings: type the name of a settings pane, like "bluetooth", "displays" or "full disk access", and press ↵ to open it. Searching for what's inside a pane works too: "wifi", "hot corners", "night shift", "time zone".

  • Pick Color: picks a color anywhere on screen with the macOS loupe and copies it as hex. ⌘↵ copies it as rgb() instead.
  • Privacy pages too: Camera, Microphone, Screen Recording, Full Disk Access and the other Privacy & Security pages open directly.
  • Hotkeys and aliases: give a settings pane or Pick Color its own shortcut in Settings → Commands.

item.title: Beacon 0.5.0
item.description:
Up Next: when a meeting with a video call is about to start or already on, it shows at the top of Beacon. Press ⌘J to join it. ↵ still opens what's selected, as before.

  • Tomorrow in My Schedule: once today's events are over, My Schedule shows tomorrow's first.
  • Hide calendars: the new Schedule tab in Settings leaves calendars like holidays or birthdays out of My Schedule and Up Next, and turns Up Next off if you'd rather not see it.

item.title: Beacon 0.4.0
item.description:
My Schedule: type "my schedule" to see today's events: what's on now, what's coming up, all-day events, and what's already over. Press ↵ to join a meeting's video call.

  • One key to join: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, FaceTime and other call links are found in the event's details. ⌘↵ opens the event in Calendar instead, and ⇧⌘C copies the link.
  • Your calendars, read only: Beacon asks for Calendar access the first time you open My Schedule, or from Set Up Permissions. Nothing about your events syncs or leaves this Mac.
  • VoiceOver: results, actions, emoji and shortcuts now have spoken labels, and VoiceOver announces the selected result as you move through the list.

item.title: Beacon 0.3.2
item.description:
iCloud sync fix: quicklinks, snippets, layouts, scripts and what you open most weren't reaching iCloud. Only settings and emoji were syncing. Beacon now sends whatever was left behind the next time it starts.

  • Sync problems stay visible: if iCloud turns down a change, Settings → General keeps showing why, instead of clearing it right away.

item.title: Beacon 0.3.1
item.description:
iCloud sync, filled in: three things that stayed behind on each Mac in 0.3.0 now follow you.

  • Apps in other places: aliases and shortcuts for an app now work on a Mac where it's installed somewhere else, such as ~/Applications. Beacon finds it by its bundle ID.
  • Search the web with: the quicklink offered at the bottom of every search now syncs. The choice you made before updating goes up once, unless another Mac already sent one.
  • Merged built-ins keep their extras: when built-in quicklinks and snippets from an older install merge with another Mac's copies, their aliases, shortcuts and ranking now come along instead of being lost.

item.title: Beacon 0.3.0
item.description:
iCloud sync: turn on Sync with iCloud in Settings → General, or in the welcome window, and Beacon keeps your Macs in step: settings and shortcuts, aliases, quicklinks, snippets, scripts, saved layouts, emoji favorites, and what you open most.

  • Private: everything goes to your own iCloud, and snippet text, quicklink URLs, scripts and window titles are end-to-end encrypted. Clipboard history never leaves the Mac it was copied on.
  • Scripts ask first: a script that arrives or changes from another Mac shows Allow and Run until you've allowed it here. Press ⌘E to read it first.
  • Each Mac stays its own: launch at login, the menu bar icon, the launcher's position, permissions, and whether snippets expand as you type are set per Mac.
  • Off by default, and turning it off keeps everything on this Mac.

item.title: Beacon 0.2.0
item.description:
• Aliases: give any app or command a short name in Settings → Commands. Type it in Beacon and that item comes first.
  • Quick Look: press ⌘Y on a file to preview it beside the list.
  • Browse folders: press → on a folder to look inside it, and ← to go back up. Type to filter.
  • Open With: press ⌘O on a file to pick the app that opens it.

item.title: Beacon 0.1.0
item.description:
The first release of Beacon, a free, Raycast-style launcher for macOS 26 and later. Press ⌥Space in any app to open it.

  • Apps and commands: fuzzy search that learns what you pick, a ⌘K actions menu, and global shortcuts for any command or app.
  • Calculator: math, unit and currency conversion, dates and time zones as you type.
  • Windows: halves, thirds, quarters, displays and more from the keyboard, drag-to-edge snapping, saved layouts, and a window switcher.
  • Files and emoji: Spotlight-backed file search and an emoji picker with skin-tone memory.
  • Extras: encrypted clipboard history, snippets that expand as you type, quicklinks and web search, system commands, and script commands.

Beacon works without any permissions; Accessibility and Input Monitoring unlock window management, pasting and snippet expansion. Updates install from inside the app.
